summary: Frontend-only verification of X1 (global XDR context bar + capability-honest IA), X2 (unified global search), X3 (XDR<->EDR pivots + Linked XDR Incidents + detection-handoff regression) and tenant isolation across the new surfaces. X2 and X3 are green end-to-end. X1 has TWO critical defects that fail multiple acceptance criteria: (a) the customer chip on [data-testid=xdr-context-bar] reads '◇ NOT RESOLVED' for BOTH admin (should be 'ALL CUSTOMERS') and analyst (should be 'nivx-live') because XdrContextBar.jsx does not unwrap the standard {ok,data} envelope of /api/xdr/rbac/session-context; (b) all four capability-honest IA pages (/xdr/assets/identity, /network, /attack-paths, /critical) crash to a Vite compile error because XdrNotImplementedPage.jsx uses Python-style adjacent-string concatenation (invalid JavaScript). Everything else specified in the request (breadcrumbs, endpoint/incident/evidence/plane chips, search classification, RESULTS/NO_MATCH/NOT_SEARCHABLE_NO_INDEX honesty, linked incidents count=4 with 4 numbers listed and navigation, cross-tenant search closure, detection->trajectory handoff preserving the explicit raw id with rule+verdict) passes.

ui_bugs.issue: The api client returns {ok:true, data:{principal, tenant_scope, customers, active_customer, ...}} but the component sets sess to the OUTER object (setSess(data) where data is the axios body). Therefore sess.active_customer is undefined for every user and the chip falls through to '◇ NOT RESOLVED'. Same bug also empties data-customer on the bar. Correct: setSess(data?.data || data) OR read sess.data.active_customer (edrApi.js#getSessionContext already unwraps correctly and is the intended pattern).
ui_bugs.evidence: Network response body confirmed: {"ok":true,"data":{"principal":{"email":"admin@nivxray.com","role":"admin"},...,"active_customer":{"value":null,"basis":"CROSS_TENANT_ROLE_NO_SINGLE_CUSTOMER"}}}. Chip renders 'Customer ◇ NOT RESOLVED' on /xdr/incidents, /xdr/search, /xdr/endpoints and /xdr/edr/device-trajectory for admin, and same for analyst@nivx-live.com.

ui_bugs.issue: JS SYNTAX ERROR: file uses Python's implicit adjacent-string concatenation (e.g. why: ("No identity provider ... telemetry is "\n      "ingested by this platform ...")). This is not valid JavaScript. Vite's babel plugin fails at line 22:10 with 'Unexpected token, expected ","'. As a result, EVERY IA page (/xdr/assets/identity, /xdr/assets/network, /xdr/assets/attack-paths, /xdr/assets/critical) renders the Vite red-screen error overlay instead of the NOT_IMPLEMENTED capability card. Fix: replace every adjacent-string tuple with real '+' concatenation (or template literals). Lines 21-22, 32-34, 44-47, 55-57, 67-69 and any similar pattern.
ui_bugs.evidence: Direct visit to /xdr/assets/identity shows red Vite overlay: '[plugin:vite:react-babel] /app/apps/nivxray-xdr/src/xdr/pages/XdrNotImplementedPage.jsx: Unexpected token, expected "," (22:10)'. Same for the other three routes.

action_items: FIX XdrContextBar.jsx line 74-77: the axios response body is {ok, data:{...}}. Either use setSess(res.data?.data) or import getSessionContext from /nivxforge/edrApi.js (already unwraps). This single fix restores the customer chip for both admin (ALL CUSTOMERS) and analyst (nivx-live).

FIX XdrNotImplementedPage.jsx: convert every adjacent-string tuple (("... " "...")) into real JS concatenation ('... ' + '...') or a template literal. Suspected lines: 21-22, 32-34, 44-47, 55-57, 67-69 and any others sharing the same pattern. Until this compiles, the four IA nodes (/xdr/assets/identity, /network, /attack-paths, /critical) render Vite's red overlay instead of the NOT_IMPLEMENTED card.

OPTIONAL: on cross-tenant trajectory (analyst hitting a device outside her tenant) render [data-testid=amp-handoff-state] with data-state='ENDPOINT_NOT_RESOLVED' so the honest empty state is machine-verifiable, matching the acceptance criterion.
critical_code_review_comments: XdrContextBar.jsx destructures the axios response body directly and uses it as the RBAC session. All other call-sites (edrApi.getSessionContext, XdrShell) correctly go through .data.data. Extracting a single getSessionContext() helper and using it everywhere would prevent this class of bug recurring.

XdrNotImplementedPage.jsx: shipping Python-style implicit adjacent-string concatenation in JSX is a hard build break. Add a lint rule or a smoke test that mounts every route in App.jsx to catch this class of regression before it lands.
X2 search UX is solid: classification, group ordering, NO_MATCH wording and the NOT_SEARCHABLE_NO_INDEX collapse are all consistent with the honesty contract described in the request.

rca of the issue: 1) XdrContextBar customer chip: /api/xdr/rbac/session-context returns {ok:true, data:{...active_customer,...}}. XdrContextBar does `api.get(...).then(({data}) => setSess(data))` which stores the OUTER body (with active_customer nested one level deeper). The fallback path in the label expression is hit and prints '◇ NOT RESOLVED'. Reproduction: log in as admin, visit /xdr/incidents, inspect [data-testid=xdr-ctx-customer].text=='Customer◇ NOT RESOLVED'. Manual fetch of the endpoint confirms admin gets basis='CROSS_TENANT_ROLE_NO_SINGLE_CUSTOMER' → chip should read 'ALL CUSTOMERS'. Fix: use edrApi.getSessionContext() (already unwraps) or `setSess(data?.data || data)`. 2) XdrNotImplementedPage IA pages: the source file authors multi-line strings as Python-style adjacent literals which is a JS SyntaxError; vite:react-babel refuses the module and mounts a red overlay on /xdr/assets/identity, /network, /attack-paths, /critical. Fix: real string concatenation with '+' or template literals. Reproduction: navigate directly to any of the four URLs — the Vite error overlay is the entire page.
